description: This Java class defines a REST API resource for managing interest rate chart slabs (interest bands). It includes endpoints for retrieving templates, listing all slabs, retrieving an individual slab, creating, updating, and deleting slabs for a specific interest rate chart. The class uses JAX-RS annotations for REST endpoints, Swagger annotations for documentation, and interacts with service and command components for business logic and command processing.

classes.name: InterestRateChartSlabsApiResource
classes.description: A REST API resource class for managing interest rate chart slabs, providing endpoints to create, read, update, and delete slabs associated with interest rate charts.

methods.name: template
methods.description: Returns a template interest rate chart slab data object, used for creating new slabs.

methods.name: retrieveAll
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all slabs associated with a specified interest rate chart.

methods.name: retrieveOne
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific slab associated with a chart, optionally including a template.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new interest rate slab for a specified chart using data from the request.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing slab identified by its ID for a specified chart.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a specific slab associated with a chart.
